capitals.name: Bonn
capitals.note: The Germany page: West Germany 'chose Bonn as a provisional capital'; the page gives no capital for 1990-1993, so Bonn is the continuing seat of government.

correction.text: the Federal Republic and the German Democratic Republic together: 'the former East German states join the FRG on 3 October 1990'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria's row starts in 1991 but reunification was on 3 October 1990 ('3 October 1990 was the day when Germany again became a single nation-state'); the 1990 shape is the union of the two Cliopatria 1990 shapes (247,306 + 112,473 km2). Until October the two states exist separately.

360,601 km2 against the infobox 357,022 km2 (ratio 1.010), within the grid's coastline rounding. 'German territory covers 357,022 km2'. The Oder-Neisse frontier with Poland was confirmed by the border treaty signed on 14 November 1990 (reunification page), so no later change. The 'Netherlands' in the shape's country list is probably an outline sliver.
Same outline as 1991-2023 (360,601 km2); the page records no frontier change.

region.text: the Federal Republic of Germany, which the unified state continues

ledger.note: 1990-10-03: Germany is reunified. '3 October 1990 was the day when Germany again became a single nation-state'; the unified state is 'an enlarged continuation of the 1949–1990 West German state'. The Two Plus Four Treaty was signed in Moscow on 12 September 1990 and 'entered into force on 15 March 1991'.

region.text: the five new Lander and East Berlin

ledger.note: 1990-10-03: the German Democratic Republic accedes to the Federal Republic. The Volkskammer declared 'the accession (Beitritt) of the German Democratic Republic to the Federal Republic of Germany' on 23 August 1990, 'effective 3 October 1990' under Article 23 of the Basic Law; the Unification Treaty was signed on 31 August 1990.

1994: Berlin again becomes the capital. 'Based on the Berlin/Bonn Act of 1994, Berlin again became the capital of Germany'; Bonn became a Bundesstadt and the government's relocation was 'completed in 1999' (the reunification page says 2000).

certainty.note: The eastern frontier is the Oder-Neisse line, confirmed by the German-Polish border treaty signed on 14 November 1990 and in force on 16 January 1992; the other frontiers are inherited West German ones.

notes: Cliopatria's Federated Republic of Germany starts in 1991; the dossier starts on 3 October 1990 and adds a 1990 keyframe (union of the Federal Republic and the GDR shapes of 1990), so the federal-republic-of-germany and german-democratic-republic dossiers (other eu-22 parts) should end in October 1990 and 1990 will show three states unless the renderer cuts at the month. The reunification page calls the unified state 'an enlarged continuation' of West Germany, so the colour family germany continues; the orchestrator may merge the two dossiers. The Two Plus Four Treaty (in force 15 March 1991) and the Polish border treaty are not territorial events and are in notes only. The Bonn years 1990-1993 for the capital are my reading of a page that gives no capital for them; the legal capital from 3 October 1990 is not on the pages read. No ruler strip: no list was opened.
